verdict.rationale: Evidence shows GrowthBook's MCP integration lets external AI tools (Cursor, Claude, VS Code) connect to and query GrowthBook data via authenticated REST calls, but this is an outbound integration for agents, not an in-product feature where GrowthBook itself surfaces AI-generated insights or suggestions to users inside its dashboards. No docs mention native AI-generated experiment insights, anomaly explanations, or suggested actions rendered in the GrowthBook UI.
